About the project

Yukio is a desktop companion that turns the activity of supported AI tools into little character moments. This repository is her website: meet Yukio and Qianxia, try their original animations, and download the Mac app.

The website runs entirely in the browser. Its animation demo does not connect to your assistants or read local chats. The desktop application is a separate project.

Repository
leo-zhang-source / yukio-website ↗
Made with
HTML, CSS & JavaScript · no framework or build step
Languages
English & 中文 · remembers your choice

What’s inside

  • Two little personalities.

    Yukio and Qianxia, each with twelve original actions. Choose a moment, try a random move, or watch the automatic demo.

  • Pick her up. Put her down.

    Carry Yukio around the browser with gentle swing and inertia. Let go and she stays nearby, sitting at the drop position. Use the return button or Escape to bring her home.

  • A closer look at the workbench.

    Explore the Mac app through real interface screenshots using preset demo data. Open a screenshot for a larger view.

  • A quiet, comfortable home.

    Responsive pages, an English / Chinese switch, reduced-motion support, and no sound. The Mac installer includes progress, cancellation and SHA-256 verification.

Run it locally

Download and extract the source ZIP, then open a terminal in the extracted folder. Python 3 is enough to serve the website:

python3 -m http.server 4173 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory dist

Open http://127.0.0.1:4173/ ↗. Keep the terminal running while you explore. Stop the server with Ctrl+C.

Prefer Git? Clone the repository first:

git clone https://github.com/leo-zhang-source/yukio-website.git
cd yukio-website

Before sharing your changes

With Node.js 20 or newer installed, run the project checks. No npm install is needed.

npm run check
npm run test:physics
npm run test:demo

These check JavaScript, page assets, all animation timelines, installer integrity, drag physics and demo timing. Preview your changes on a phone-sized screen too.

Find your way around

The main places to start editing
File or folderWhat lives here
dist/index.htmlThe homepage and its sections.
dist/taste.cssColors, typography and responsive layout.
dist/brand-copy.jsEnglish and Chinese homepage copy.
dist/app.jsAnimation playback, navigation and page interactions.
dist/pet-*.jsCarrying, drag physics and the automatic action demo.
dist/assets/Character artwork, sprite sheets, screenshots and fonts.
dist/downloads/The original Mac installer in verified parts.
dist/source.*
dist/source-page.js		This source guide, its style and language switch.
scripts/Validation, copy syncing and asset provenance.

After editing brand-copy.js, run node scripts/sync-copy.mjs to update the homepage’s initial English HTML too. The deployable folder is dist/.

The desktop app

Want Yukio to live on your desktop? The current website download is Yukio 5.3 for Apple silicon Mac, with the desktop companion and activity workbench. Windows distribution remains paused; historical Intel Mac v0.4.6 is available.

Mac download & installation ↗Desktop app repository ↗

The desktop app source and history are restored under leo-zhang-source. Its main branch includes ongoing Mac development; the 5.4 candidate is not an accepted release. The ZIP above contains website source. Use the separate desktop repository for app source. Original packages retain old update addresses; use manual downloads.

Credits & reuse

Character artwork and original animation come from the Yukio desktop-pet project. The website plays the original frame sequences and timings. Asset provenance is recorded in the repository’s scripts folder.

Fredoka and ZCOOL KuaiLe are self-hosted. Their font licenses are included in dist/assets/.

This repository does not currently declare a project license. Public access is not a license grant; check the included notices and obtain the relevant permissions before redistributing code, character artwork or installer files.
